# mmCal V1.5 exact integer / Rational regression
# BigInt, Rational normalization, exact decimal, rounding boundaries.

# BigInt: fixed-width overflow must not exist.
123456789012345678901234567890==>123456789012345678901234567890
123456789012345678901234567890+1==>123456789012345678901234567891
999999999999999999999999999999*999999999999999999999999999999==>999999999999999999999999999998000000000000000000000000000001
10^50==>100000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
(10^100+1)-10^100==>1
(10^100-1)/(10^50-1)==>100000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001
2^100==>1267650600228229401496703205376
(-1)^1000==>1
(-1)^1001==>-1
2^-3==>1/8
(-1)^-1==>-1
(-1)^-2==>1

# Rational canonicalization / cancellation.
1/3==>1/3
2/4==>1/2
(-2)/4==>-1/2
2/(-4)==>-1/2
(-2)/(-4)==>1/2
0/7==>0
0/(-7)==>0
99999999999999999999/99999999999999999999==>1
12345678901234567890/10==>1234567890123456789
1/3+1/6==>1/2
1/2-1/3==>1/6
2/3*9/4==>3/2
(2/3)/(4/5)==>5/6
(100000000000000000000/3)*(3/100000000000000000000)==>1

# Decimal literals are exact Rational, not IEEE-754 binary floating point.
0.1==>1/10
0.10==>1/10
1.2300==>123/100
0.000==>0
.5==>1/2
5.==>5
0.1+0.2==>3/10
0.1+0.2==0.3==>True
0.3-0.2-0.1==>0
1.0000000000000000000000000000000000000001-1==>1/10000000000000000000000000000000000000000
0.0000000000000000000000000000000000000001==>1/10000000000000000000000000000000000000000

# Scientific notation remains exact too.
1e0==>1
1e+0==>1
1e-0==>1
1e3==>1000
1E3==>1000
1e-3==>1/1000
1e01==>10
01e2==>100
1e20==>100000000000000000000
1e-20==>1/100000000000000000000

# Integer-valued utilities and negative-boundary semantics.
floor[3/2]==>1
floor[-3/2]==>-2
ceil[3/2]==>2
ceil[-3/2]==>-1
trunc[3/2]==>1
trunc[-3/2]==>-1
round[1/2]==>0
round[3/2]==>2
round[5/2]==>2
round[7/2]==>4
round[-1/2]==>0
round[-3/2]==>-2
round[-5/2]==>-2
round[-7/2]==>-4
frac[3/2]==>1/2
frac[-3/2]==>1/2
quotient[5,3]==>1
quotient[-5,3]==>-1
quotient[5,-3]==>-1
quotient[-5,-3]==>1
rem[5,3]==>2
rem[-5,3]==>-2
rem[5,-3]==>2
rem[-5,-3]==>-2
mod[5,3]==>2
mod[-5,3]==>1
mod[5,-3]==>-1
mod[-5,-3]==>-2

# Discrete exact functions at natural boundaries.
gcd[0,0]==>0
gcd[-84,126]==>42
lcm[0,5]==>0
lcm[-6,8]==>24
comb[0,0]==>1
comb[5,0]==>1
